messages:
Elliot: quick discovery during a docs sweep: several pages still show the old function_call payload, and a handful of example links 404. i'd like to split into two quick PRs: A) redirects/fixes, B) snippet migrations + small migration note. who can pick what?

Mina: i can do the redirects first. please paste the grep or issue.

Elliot: added findings to issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/1102. hotspots: /docs/guides/tool-calling/, /docs/examples/, and /docs/reference/structured-output/. there are also two external blog links referencing old slugs.

Raj: ill take snippet migrations (py + ts) once redirects are in. proposed minimal snippet change in py: 
# old
resp = client.chat.completions.create(..., function_call={"name": "lookup_user"})
# new
resp = client.chat.completions.create(..., tools=[lookup_user])
I'll add a one-line comment about providing a JSON schema for the tool args and show compact-envelope usage.

Mina: running linkcheck now. CI output shows:
LinkChecker: 404 on /examples/tool-old.md (referenced in /docs/guides/tool-calling/index.md)
and a few other misses. will open PR A for redirects.

CI-Bot: automated: linkcheck found 8 broken links in the latest run. full artifact: https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/links/1102

Elliot: PR A should just move old files to /docs/legacy-examples/ and add redirect stubs. keep it small so it merges fast. PR B can contain code snippets, a 3-line migration note in /docs/migration.md, and a compact-envelope example under /docs/reference/structured-output/compact-envelope.md.

Mina: PR A opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5277 (redirects + legacy moves). tagging @Raj for awareness.

Raj: i'll prepare PR B branch with snippets and a tiny migration note. also adding a tiny test harness example for parser fallback ordering (schema -> compact-envelope -> heuristics) so authors can run it locally.

Mina: PR A passed preview checks and merged. redirects live. :tada:

Raj: PR B draft: includes py + ts before/after snippets, compact envelope example, migration note (3 lines), and a Jest/pytest snippet showing parser ordering. sample compact envelope in docs: {"envelope": {"tool_call": {"name":"summarize","args":{"text":"..."}}, "output_schema": {"type":"object","properties":{"summary":{"type":"string"}},"required":["summary"]}}} (we'll format properly in the page).

Elliot: for guardrails add a short bullet: prefer explicit property types, avoid union-of-arrays at the top level, and mark critical fields as required in the schema. also mention how to use parser fallbacks explicitly.

DocsBot: automated: docs preview for PR B built: https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.io/preview/5288. build artifact attached.

Raj: pushed a tiny compatibility shim for older SDKs that don't accept tools=[...], just a one-liner example and a note that teams should upgrade when possible.

Mina: reviewed PR B and left a minor wording nit on the migration note. CI preview looks clean.

Raj: addressed the nit, rebased, and requested final review.

Elliot: approved and left one suggestion to call out external blog links that might still need manual correction.

DocsBot: automated: PR B merged. linkcheck post-merge run shows no remaining broken links in the affected areas.

Elliot: nice. follow-ups: 1) i'll open an issue to sweep Python examples across the site next week, 2) Mina add a short README into /docs/legacy-examples/ explaining why items were moved and how to request un-deprecation, 3) Raj please drop the parser test example into /docs/examples/parse-tests/ with run instructions.

Mina: will add the README in a follow-up PR tomorrow.

Raj: adding the parse-tests README now. thanks all!
